items.title: Nifty Eyes 26,200 Amid Strong FII Inflows
items.summary: Indian benchmark indices recorded solid gains recently, driven by robust foreign institutional investor inflows and positive technical indicators. The Nifty rose over two and a half percent over the week, moving past significant resistance levels with banking and financial sectors leading the charge. Market participants are closely watching whether the index can sustain momentum to test higher milestones in the upcoming sessions.
items.why: Tracking benchmark indices helps investors gauge broader market sentiment and sector rotation patterns.

items.title: Precious and Industrial Metals Plummet to Multi-Month Lows
items.summary: Metal prices experienced sharp declines globally, with gold slipping near fourteen-month lows and silver reaching multi-month troughs. The selloff was accelerated by rising US bond yields, a stronger dollar, shifting Federal Reserve rate expectations, and persistent inflation concerns. This dramatic drop reverses a large portion of the gains built up over the past year across various precious and industrial commodities.
items.why: Global commodity selloffs impact domestic retail bullion prices and domestic mining equities.

items.title: National Stock Exchange Becomes World's Fifth-Largest Exchange
items.summary: The National Stock Exchange of India has climbed significantly in global rankings by market capitalization, overtaking major international peers like Nasdaq and Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing. This milestone reflects the rapid expansion of India's capital markets, surging retail participation, and robust corporate listings over recent years. The achievement highlights India's growing prominence in the global financial ecosystem.
items.why: Exchange market capitalisation reflects the sheer scale and economic weight of a nation's capital markets.

items.title: Wall Street Suffers Sharp Weekly Rout as Nasdaq Turns Negative
items.summary: US equities faced a severe weekly selloff, driven by cooling enthusiasm for artificial intelligence stocks and broader economic worries. The Nasdaq slipped into negative territory for the year as high-flying technology valuations faced heavy profit-booking. Investors are now reassessing portfolio risk amid shifting monetary policy expectations and upcoming macroeconomic data releases.
items.why: US market corrections frequently influence global equity sentiment and foreign portfolio flows into emerging markets.

items.title: US Markets Brace for Key GDP, PCE Inflation and Earnings
items.summary: Wall Street faces a packed economic calendar featuring third-quarter GDP figures and the crucial October Personal Consumption Expenditures price index released simultaneously. Markets will also digest corporate earnings reports from major tech and retail names during a shortened trading week due to Thanksgiving. Traders are scanning these data points for clues on the Federal Reserve's next policy moves.
items.why: US inflation and growth data dictate global interest rate trajectories and currency valuations.

items.title: Infrastructure Investment Trust IPO Pipeline Expands Rapidly
items.summary: Infrastructure Investment Trusts are ramping up public offerings, with multiple private trusts planning to raise billions of rupees through public listings by March 2027. These financial vehicles are designed to mobilize long-term capital required to fund large-scale infrastructure projects across the country. The growing pipeline indicates strong institutional and retail demand for yield-generating infrastructure assets.
items.why: InvITs offer an alternative route for funding capital-intensive public works while providing regular income to investors.

items.title: Crude Oil Prices Surge Amid Escalating Geopolitical Tensions
items.summary: Domestic equity benchmarks faced downward pressure as crude oil futures rallied sharply in response to growing conflict concerns involving Iran. Higher energy import costs present a macro risk for India, which imports the vast majority of its crude requirements. Energy market volatility remains a critical variable for domestic inflation and the country's current account deficit.
items.why: Crude oil is a vital input cost that directly influences domestic inflation, fuel prices, and macroeconomic stability in India.

items.title: India Projects Strong GDP Growth Alongside Potential Rate Hike
items.summary: Economic reports project India's gross domestic product growth to remain robust at around seven percent for the current fiscal year. Simultaneously, analysts anticipate the central bank may consider a modest quarter-point interest rate increase in the upcoming monetary policy review to manage liquidity and price stability. These forecasts underscore a resilient domestic economy balancing growth with inflationary pressures.
items.why: GDP growth and central bank interest rate decisions form the foundational baseline for corporate earnings and borrowing costs.
